title: Overcast Compat Generated Test Registry
description: Machine-generated sibling of registry.json. Every loader concatenates the two; the join key (group name, test name) is shared, so a generated group may never reuse a hand-written name. Rewritten wholly by cmd/compatgen — never hand-edited. See docs/plans/compat-coverage-modelgen.md § 3.6.

GeneratedTestGroup.description: The shared TestGroup shape plus the three fields that only generated groups carry. The shape is $ref'd rather than copied: the two registries are joined on group and test names, so a second copy of the definition could drift and start accepting names the hand-written registry rejects.

generated.description: Always true. Marks the group as generator output for the dashboard facet, the report and the lint — 'which file did this come from' must never be inferred from a naming convention.

scenario.description: Path to the scenario IR file this group was generated from, relative to the repository root. Regenerating from that file must reproduce the group byte-identically; it is also how a reviewer gets from a failing test back to the recipe that produced it.

state.description: candidate = runs everywhere and reports everywhere, but gates nothing: excluded from both --compare-baseline and --max-failures. The inverse of flaky.json — quarantined by default until it proves itself, rather than gated by default until someone gets a label. gated = has passed the soak and is enforced exactly like a hand-written group.

suites.description: Mechanically derived from backend availability by cmd/compatgen, never hand-edited. A suite absent from this list neither implements the group nor carries parity debt for it — which is what keeps a model refresh from inflating debt for six suites that were never asked to run the tests.
